newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil to spud first well on China Lufeng field.
newsitem.headline: Statoil to spud first well on China Lufeng field.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) will spud the first of five production wells on the Lufeng 22-1 oil development in the South China Sea in mid November, the company's Status Weekly newsletter said on Thursday.
Due to come onstream in the second half of 1997, Lufeng 22-1 lies in 330 metres and will produce via a ship tied-back to a subsea template.
The development is part of an established oil province about 250 kilometres off Hong Kong, Statoil said.
The rig Nan Hai V, chartered from the China Offshore Southern Drilling Co, will move to Lufeng when it has completed work for Chevron in the same waters.
